description: Spatial Bench in the Verse Engine by Ctruh docs: what it is, how to use it, and where it fits in your 3D workflow.

docs.article:
Spatial Bench#

Spatial Bench runs four tests in a real Verse viewer on **your own device** and gives one score, the Verse Spatial Score. It takes about a minute and a half and you can cancel at any point.

TestWhat it does
Product openOpens a product scene and measures how quickly it opens.
Interior walkWalks a fixed route through a furnished interior.
Large exteriorStreams a large outdoor scene along a fixed route.
StressThe same scene at four times the pixels.

Why you can trust the numbers#

  • Every number comes from the engine's own counters or a clock on the page, not an estimate.
  • The routes are fixed (same seed, same path), so two runs on the same device are comparable.
  • The score formula and its reference points are printed on the page.

Sharing a result#

Share creates a link with the numbers and the GPU and browser names only. It carries no name, address or account. You can also opt in to a leaderboard grouped by device class; partial runs, repeat runs and outliers are skipped.

Tips#

  • Close other tabs, plug a laptop in, and run it twice: the first run warms the caches.
  • A phone on battery saver will score lower. That is a true result for that phone in that state.
  • If the page says the bench scenes are "not set up yet", the server you opened has not enabled them; use verse.ctruh.com.
